values.task_boundary: Add the WP-18 demo runner, validator, fixtures, artifacts, and D1-D6 matrix updates without absorbing consumer integration, provider comparison, governance, or publication.
deliverables: Runtime-produced positive packet and deterministic validator
Not-a-birthday fixture matrix and rejection report
Reviewer index and D1-D6 exact command/artifact updates
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One documented command emits a structurally complete Runtime-produced birthday packet.
AC-2: Startup, wake, restore, snapshot, admission, copied state, simulation, named fixture, and missing-evidence cases reject with typed reasons.
AC-3: Replay, interruption, redaction, and macOS/Linux packet validation pass with allowed nondeterminism declared.
AC-4: D1-D6 and the reviewer index cite exact commands, artifacts, and revisions without publication overclaim.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.
non_goals: Legal personhood, consciousness, production citizenship, or public launch
